ModMetaData.name: HSK Outposts
ModMetaData.author: Sonsalt
ModMetaData.description:
Balances Vanilla Outposts Expanded (and VOE: Additional Outposts, if active) for Hardcore SK on RimWorld 1.7.
Outposts are built from "outpost construction materials" (planks, stone blocks, metal, fasteners), plus kits for the artillery and science outposts, and need minimum skills. - Food: HSK and Vile's meals (HSK removes the Ideology meals VOE uses). - Mining yields HSK ores by total mining skill, not finished steel or plasteel. Logging yields Vile's wood species. - The production outpost (free components) is removed. Drilling, trading and scavenging pay less, and artillery outposts fire shells close to HSK's 81 mm HE. - Additional Outposts: build costs, silver, drug and meal output roughly halved for HSK's scarcer economy; their outpost maps use HSK/Vile's materials. - Settings/Mod_2023507013_OutpostsMod.xml: optional HSK values for the mod-settings sliders (pack-animal delivery, smaller fines, church/prison/embassy/bank income). Copy it into your RimWorld Config folder if you have no outposts settings yet.
Based on the HSK patch in TheLoneTec's "Tec's Assorted Patches" (1.3-1.5), ported to 1.7 and extended. Credits: TheLoneTec (original design), Oskar Potocki and the Vanilla Expanded team (VOE), MrHydralisk (Additional Outposts).
